page_title: MAL 2-1 RMA | Mallorca v Real Madrid 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Jose Sanchez has issued a yellow card to Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca).
90+4' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+1' Although Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is just on the bench, Jose Sanchez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+1' 2 - 1 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) gets a yellow card. The referee Jose Sanchez made the right call.
88' 1 - 1 Trent Alexander-Arnold takes the corner and Eder Militao (Real Madrid) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
87' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

87' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
87' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
84' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card.
84' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
83' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
81' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo makes way for Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).

78' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
77' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
76' Substitution. Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) on for Brahim Diaz.

74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
74' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Mallorca win a corner.
72' Substitution. Arda Guler walks off the pitch and Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
70' Substitution. Jan Virgili (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pablo Torre walks off.
70' The attendance is 23015.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manu Morlanes trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mateo Joseph (Mallorca).
70' Martin Demichelis decides to make a substitution. Samu Costa will be replaced by David Lopez (Mallorca).
67' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' The referee Jose Sanchez awards Leo Roman (Mallorca) a yellow card.
65' Wasted effort! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
59' Substitution. Eduardo Camavinga makes his way off the pitch and Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
59' Alvaro Arbeloa prepares a substitution. Dean Huijsen is replaced by Eder Militao (Real Madrid).
59' The game has come to an end for Manuel Angel Moran Ibanez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
57' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Leo Roman.
53' Manuel Angel Moran Ibanez (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
50' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
47' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) sees a yellow card from Jose Sanchez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

41' 1 - 0 Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) scores a goal after nicely controlling a pass and unleashing a powerful close-range shot into the bottom right corner. The keeper couldn't do anything to stop this wonderful effort.
39' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
39' A lofted cross from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
36' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) commits a foul after dangerous play. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
34' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Arda Guler (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Leo Roman easily catches the ball.
34' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Mallorca win a free kick.

30' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Sanchez with no other option than to blow for a foul. Mallorca get a free kick.
26' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
25' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) will take a corner kick.
23' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
22' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Madrid.
22' Great save! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Leo Roman.

19' Manuel Angel Moran Ibanez (Real Madrid) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Sanchez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Mallorca have a free kick.
18' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Manuel Angel Moran Ibanez (Real Madrid) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the right post, but Leo Roman is alert and denies him.
16' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
15' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
13' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and it's Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
5' The linesman signals that Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
4' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
4' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is the one to supervise the game today.
